name: Greggs
story: This family holds the record for Jenny Greggs, who died at age three. Her parents are linked to her by relationship.
testPurposes: Deceased child record kept in its own family.

members.bio: Jenny died when she was three. Her record is kept in its own family and linked to her parents, Bob and Lorraine, by relationship. Use it to test how Rock handles deceased children.
